user_story: As a user, I want the system to handle an email with special characters correctly during registration so that valid edge-case emails are accepted.

positive.title: Registering with a valid email containing standard special characters
steps: Enter a valid email such as 'user+name@example.com' in the email field.
Fill out all other mandatory fields.
positive.expected_result: The system accepts the email and successfully registers the user.

negative.title: Rejecting an invalid email format with consecutive special characters
steps: Enter an invalid email such as 'user..name@example.com' in the email field.
Fill out all other mandatory fields.
negative.expected_result: The system rejects the registration and displays an error message indicating an invalid email format.

edge.title: Handling an email with uncommon but valid special characters
steps: Enter an email such as 'user_name@sub-domain.example.travel' in the email field.
Fill out all other mandatory fields.
edge.expected_result: The system accepts the email and successfully registers the user.
